subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: When rendering a document, the reading room shall produce the view through the repo's codified transforms — the doc renderer for markdown classes and the plan renderer for plans — never through an independent markdown pipeline.
rationale: one transform layer; no drift between surfaces
fit_criterion: golden fixtures: rendered output matches the equivalence bar each class's golden fixture pins (recorded in the fixture itself); a plan document routes through the plan renderer
